description: This file defines the 'MessageElement' class, which implements handling for 'fail-message' and 'fail-property' elements within the MiniLang framework of the OFBiz project. It includes methods for parsing XML elements, validating attributes, and retrieving messages or properties based on the context.

classes.name: MessageElement
classes.description: Represents the MiniLang 'fail-message' and 'fail-property' elements, providing methods for parsing, validation, and message resolution based on environment context.

methods.name: fromParentElement
methods.description: Static factory method to create a MessageElement from a parent XML element, based on whether it contains 'fail-message' or 'fail-property' child elements.

methods.name: MessageElement
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the MessageElement by parsing relevant attributes and validating them, depending on whether the element is 'fail-message' or 'fail-property'.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the message string, either directly from 'message' attribute or by looking up properties based on 'property' and 'resource' attributes, depending on the element type.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the MessageElement, mainly for debugging purposes, showing its configured attributes.
